description: Finds maimai DX songs by title, alias, nickname, romanization or artist, best match first, with the level and internal level (譜面定数) of each chart. Use it to get the song ID of a song the user names.

limit.description: Most songs to return, 1 to 50. Default 10.

query.description: Title, alias, nickname, romanization or artist, in any language: ウミユリ海底譚, umiyuri, 海底谭, n-buna. Width, case, kana and punctuation are ignored.

type.description: Only the songs that have a chart of this type, and only those charts: dx, std, utage or utage2p

name: search_songs

dataAsOf.description: When the catalog was last updated

matched.description: The name of the song the query matched

difficulty.description: basic, advanced, expert, master, remaster, or the label of an utage chart: 【習】

internalLevel.description: Internal level (譜面定数) of the current version, which ratings are made of

type.description: dx (DX chart), std (standard chart), utage or utage2p (宴, joke charts)

version.description: Game version the song was added in

title: Search songs
